name: instance_who_am_i_json
about: A successful authenticated unary call: the principal the auth layer admitted. `loams dev` with auth off admits a loopback caller as the `dev-loopback` principal (#436), so this answers rather than refusing. `not_implemented` is recorded from the apps mock instead. (The proto3 JSON mapping, which is what `curl` sends (design §44 §4).)
